maria: quick idea 3: launch quick-win experiment: 20 starter credits + 3 one-line prompts + a 20-min how-to. goal: first 'aha' <24h. share ops + creative asks.
ashley: split creative lanes: 'build' (code prompts) vs 'create' (copy prompts). both need 3 short examples.
jon: seg rule: if signup indicates 'search' or 'indexing' -> embed lane, else gen lane. simple mapping.
sam: ops: credits expire 7d, throttle 75rpm default for new users. we can gate to new accounts only.
maria: cadence: 0h email+credits, 6h in-app nudge, 18h reminder+webinar invite, 48h last-chance. compress window to 48h.
ashley: subject lines to A/B test: "20 credits to try Redwood in 3 mins" vs "Try these 3 prompts 30 free credits inside". A/B top two.
jon: metrics: activation = first_success; retention = +7d active; cost metric = token-cost per activated user.
maria: infra checklist: create env flag welcome_quick_v1, wire events: credits_granted, prompt_used, first_success, webinar_registered, tag model_name + variant.
growth-bot: experiment created welcome_quick_v1 (id: exp_20260502_4). traffic: 10% initial, auto-ramp rules configured.
sam: rollout plan: Fri 8am PT, 10% for 24h, ramp to 35% if healthy. alerts: pause if first_success <25% or cost/activation > $1.
maria: deliverables: prompt pack drafts (3 prompts each lane), email A/B, in-app copy, 20s embed gif. deadlines: drafts Thu EOD, infra ready Fri AM.
ashley: i'll deliver creative and landing copy.
jon: i'll prep seg mapping and analytics key QA.
sam: i'll wire flags, quotas, and alerts. will post runbook link.
maria: thanks team 3 keep replies short so we can iterate fast.
